metaDescription: Customizable, maker-driven competition gear, open-source designs, how-to videos, and SplitShot software from Klock Holding Co.
heroHeading: Built for shooters who want it their way.
heroText: Klock Holding Co. is a one-man shop making customizable belts, attachments, and 3D-printed gear for competitive shooters. The design files are shared openly; finished gear is available for the people who would rather buy than build.
